notes.title: WooLoop Major Update Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]First Week is a Success - Thank You![/h1]
WooLoop has been downloaded and played by so many of you! Your reception of the game has completely blown us away and we can't thank you enough! ❤

You have all played enough collectively for over 4 and a half years of playtime! For one week of gameplay that is staggering! Well done!

All of your feedback and comments are welcome, thank you to everyone who has helped identify improvements and suggestions for the game, a lot of which we have addressed in this patch.
Please keep your comments coming, either on Discord, Steam or even on our Website, so we can keep improving WooLoop to the best of our abilities.

[h1]A Note on Achievements[/h1]
This patch brings Gallery 5, which was missing from the launch of the game. The Gallery has 21 images just like all the rest, however; Only the first 6 levels have achievements tied to them. The reason for this is that we have hit the limit of 100 achievements that are linked to new games. 

Once we pass Steam's checks and become an official release on Steam, we will be updating the Achievement list to include the rest of Gallery 5 and beyond. Thank you for your understanding.

[h1]Next Weeks DLC[/h1]
In case you missed it, we have the first DLC for WooLoop releasing next Friday! The Fantasy DLC adds a whole new Gallery to the game with 21 new images for you to Loop! 

All images are in the Fantasy Genre so will cover things magical and wonderful from start to finish.

Available on the 27th of January for $0.99/£0.79 or your regional equivalent: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2213370/WooLoop__Fantasy_Pack/

notes.title: Happy New Year and Getting Ready for Release!
notes.notes:
[h1]Happy New Year![/h1]
We are all back to work for 2023 and hope you have all had an enjoyable Holiday and New Year! 

We have relaxed as much as we can to get ready for the next couple of very busy weeks as we get ready for the release of WooLoop!

[h1]Only 10 days until release![/h1]
We are counting down the final days until release and we are very excited!
We are also very busy with the final preparations. 

Rob is currently working through the final graphical bugs we have found in order to make sure the game is as clean as possible for release.
Lee is starting all of the contacts and messages to content creators, Steam curators and press companies for our main marketing push.

All that is left is a number of levels that are still left to be made, in order to hit this deadline we are very excited to say we have hired a temporary level designer to help Rob with our level creation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259533/c9872b44a8a71d032a7a0d4d520d57e3790fd556.png[/img]

As we count down the final days to the launch of WooLoop we hope you are as excited to play the final game as we are! Make sure you add WooLoop to your wishlist now to get notified of its release on the 13th of January!


[h1]Livestreaming[/h1]
Make sure you are following us on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/toastielabs]Twitch channel[/url] to get notified when we go live again this Friday!

We will also be broadcasting gameplay footage here on Steam on launch day!

notes.title: WooLoop Update and Pricing Model
notes.notes:
[h1]WooLoop Game Pricing[/h1]

[b]WooLoop will be Free![/b]

Here at ToastieLabs, we believe games should be for everyone. With that in mind, like some of our other titles on Steam, we release games for free and offer optional DLC at the lowest price we can on Steam $0.99!

The game will be Free and offer 5 Galleries (plus 1 Bonus Gallery) of string art to complete! Each Gallery will contain 21 unique pieces of art for you to create.
After some quick maths, this means you will get over 100 levels to play for free when you download WooLoop!

[h2]DLC[/h2]
In order to provide even more levels for you to play, we are committing to offering 12 months of DLC, 1 DLC for each month of 2023!
Each DLC will contain a new Gallery of 21 pieces of art, we are going to be offering these DLC at $0.99 (the lowest price Steam allows).
Each DLC will launch on the 4th Friday of each month, with the exception of December's planned DLC "Advent", which will feature 24 levels and slight changes to the release schedule which we will confirm at a later date.

Over the course of the 12 months of releases, that will be an additional 255 Levels to play!

We hope this will be plenty to keep you entertained through the year 2023.

Also, make sure to join our Discord as we will be doing monthly giveaways for each DLC!

[h1]Game Progress[/h1]
It has been a hectic couple of weeks where we have made many updates to the appearance of the game in order to look as good as possible for the Game Trailer which we have just started editing!

New Features
[list]
[*] Allow players to use Right-Click to move without triggering the UI snap-back
[*] Added toggle click to pick up and put down the rope as an alternative to holding left click
[*] Added background colours to levels
[/list]
Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Rope clipping on Tree House Level
[*] Fixed instructions turning yellow when the next instruction is anti-clockwise
[*] Fixed UI instruction wiggle
[*] Fixed off-screen instructions breaking
[/list]

Most of the adjustments were for visual updates in order to make the game as aesthetic as possible when recording clips for the game trailer which will be released in the coming weeks.

This along with multiple new levels as we are ramping up level creation in preparation for sharing Early Access keys for marketing purposes!


[h1]Livestreaming[/h1]
Make sure you are following us on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/toastielabs]Twitch channel[/url] to get notified when we go live again this Friday!

notes.title: WooLoop Progress Update: 16/11/2022
notes.notes:
[h1]Game Progress[/h1]
Following the live stream QA Testing on Friday, we have sat down and rethought our approach towards the in-level instructions.

This has been the focus of this weeks work along with some minor bug fixing from the reports we found on Friday.

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Spelling Mistakes corrected on the settings page.
[*] Fixed an FPS drop issue
[*] Re-Fixed 180degree instructions showing incorrectly 
[*] Fixed the ability to zoom in further than the screen lets you
[*] Changed the UI for the head of the rope to make it always visible
[*] Changed the appearance of the Gallery name pop-ups to differentiate between them and the UI buttons.
[/list]

After testing the new control system we are happy with the direction it takes the game feel but we know it needs tweaking to make it smoother. This is being looked at with 3 main points to address. 
[list][*] Make the movement smoother/less snappy
[*] Address the camera movement making the player over-move if they are moving the mouse simultaneously.
[*] Find a better solution for pins that are far apart without forcing the game to zoom out.
[/list]
We have discussed a method to address the in-level UI as currently, the UI often overlaps each other and simply making the UI smaller to prevent this makes it hard to read when zoomed out.
We are trialling a solution this week of adding a UI bar with "rope selection" to remove all of the clutter from the screen and only give the player one set of instructions at a time. Check back next week to see what progress we have on this.


[h1]Livestreaming[/h1]
Make sure you are following us on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/toastielabs]Twitch channel[/url] to get notified when we go live again next Friday (25/11/2022)

[h1]Game Progress[/h1]
It's been another very busy week for WooLoop development, so much so that the game has very notable, huge differences since last week!

[b]Saving and Loading[/b] has been fully implemented and is ready to go, thorough testing is still required but this is a big step towards finalising WooLoop for release.

A number of [b]Quality of Life improvements[/b] have been implemented this week too:
[list]
[*] Increased Instruction size and zoom levels
[*] QOL changes to screen panning
[*] Loop counter, % progress and timer
[/list]
Ongoing bug fixing has been happening throughout as well as we address the number of bugs you reported during the Next Fest Demo.

One of the biggest changes we have made this week is to the pins, taking your feedback on board about being too colourful and distracting, we have made the pins match the game art on Steam as well as adding a gradient colour to highlight the route you are taking, see the GIF below as an example.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259533/e3ce0d5835f7c02683250ef23484ed6b15804fc9.gif[/img]
Please note this is still work-in-progress so expect to see changes before release.

Stop by our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/toastielabs]Twitch channel[/url] on Friday to watch us test all of the above changes plus more as we QA test the game live with chat interaction.

notes.title: Developer Progress Update: 05/10/2022
notes.notes:
[h1]Next Fest Mid Week Update[/h1]
We're only 3 days through the Steam Next Fest and we are blown away by your reception and appreciation of WooLoop! 🤎

We worked tirelessly over the past week to make sure the Demo was as ready as it could be, taking players' feedback on board we added new features to make the gameplay smoother and more relaxing. As well as tackling a number of pesky bugs.

Based on your community feedback, Rob has made some considerable changes to the game which you can see below. 


[h1]V0.106 Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new Accessibility tab in the Settings menu
[*] Added a new setting "Edge Of Screen Panning" (defaulted to on) - When enabled, the screen can pan when you reach the edge of the screen with a rope.
[*] Added a new setting "Panning Speed" (defaulted to 1x) - This setting lets you control the speed at which the edge of the screen panning setting and keyboard controls move the camera.
[*] Added a new setting "Dark Mode" (defaulted to off) - Requested by our community, so we did it <3. This is a work in progress, we hope to add more to this feature in the future.
[/list]

[h1]V0.110 Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Edge of screen panning changes
[list][*] It now works when you have let go of the rope
[*] We have also shortened the distance from the edge of the window before it activates
[*] It now stops when the game loses focus[/list]
[*] Major improvements to the responsiveness and visibility of instructions
[list][*] Reduced the number of upcoming instructions visible at once
[*] The changing colour of instructions is much more responsive. Now light blue should always be the instruction you need to complete, and dark blue is a previous instruction.
[*] When an instruction is offscreen, if it is light blue it will always be full scale[/list]
[*] Main Menu Scroll bars have been added
[*] Main Menu scroll speed has been increased
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced Panning Speed and made slight adjustments based on how zoomed in you are
[*] Fixed multiple occurrences of anticlockwise instructions sometimes being incorrect
[/list]

[h1]What's coming next?[/h1]
More Next Fest!
We were amazed at how well you all seemed to enjoy our live broadcast yesterday, we have a second live stream scheduled for tomorrow, Thursday the 6th at 1pm BST. Make sure you stop by again to say hello and get involved with any questions you may have for us, the developers.

The Demo itself will be live for another week or so, so make sure you download the demo whilst you still can and let us know what you think. We are spending the week analysing all the data and feedback we get from players and will be posting a wrap-up of all our findings. This will let you know what improvements to the game we will be making for the full release in January based on your own feedback!

Thank you all for playing!

Add WooLoop to your wishlist now to follow along with our journey to release in 2023!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1878910

notes.title: Developer Broadcast - Watch us QA the game up to release!
notes.notes:
[h1]Streaming Live![/h1]

Get the very first public look at WooLoop gameplay directly from the developers today!

We will be streaming some of the currently ready levels today to show off what the gameplay will look like as well as allowing us to test the game and note down any bugs or features that need addressing.

We will be streaming live at around 1:30PM BST for about 30 to 45 minutes (no strict time frame) with chat enabled so if you want to come along and say hi and ask any questions, please do!

I am currently setting up the hardware in our new office so we expect a couple of teething issues with the first stream or two, we thank you in advance for your patience and understanding. 



[i]p.s. The game is still in its very early stages so we expect to find a few problems and things like the UI and game menu aren't finished yet[/i]


[h2]Streaming schedule[/h2]
We are aiming to be streaming every Friday around the same time in the build-up to the Steam Next Fest so make sure you stop by to watch the ongoing development of WooLoop.

Any changes to the schedule will be updated during the week.
